name: Beacon
author: E. T. Carter
description: A lighthouse beam turns slowly through a bank of night fog from a lantern just off the left edge. Dim cool haze fills the frame edge to edge; where the beam passes, dense clumps throw long soft shadow shafts down its length and the light reads as volume. Between sweeps the fog settles into a clean even field with room for a wordmark.

params.label: Sweep speed
params.effect: How fast the lantern turns; 0 holds the beam still while the fog keeps drifting through it.

params.label: Beam width
params.effect: Angular half-width of the beam in degrees, from a hard searchlight blade to a broad soft fan.

params.label: Fog density
params.effect: Thickness of the fog bank: thin air shows a faint clean beam, thick fog shows heavy clumps and deep shadow shafts.

params.label: Lantern height
params.effect: Where the off-frame lantern sits on the left edge, as a fraction of frame height; moves the whole sweep up or down.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer adds a faint second lantern in the fog; 0 ignores the mouse.
